scientific_integrity: Proved conditional on existence of a finite affine plane of order q; uses its incidence axioms and the classical Schoenberg equivalence. scientific_limitations: Does not classify positive semidefiniteness at one fixed Gaussian scale above the universal threshold.
Assumes a finite affine plane of the stated order exists.
An older equivalent formulation concerning resolvable-design incidence metrics cannot be ruled out by bounded prior-art inspection.
title: Sharp universal Gaussian-kernel threshold on finite affine-plane incidence graphs
